prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1427; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. Presenting complaints included neck and low back pain with muscle tension and reduced range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent in kind and force with the strain pattern documented on examination. Some findings, including paraspinal muscle tenderness and limited cervical rotation, support the clinical picture, while other orthopedic and neurological screening tests were within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar regions is known to this provider or reported in the history. Conservative care consisted of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching program. The patient completed 29 visits, a somewhat longer course than typically expected for a strain of this type, with gradual improvement noted over the course of care. Billing records reviewed for the episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. At the most recent evaluation, pain was reduced and function was improving, and the patient was advised to continue the home exercise program as needed.
